entries.gloss: The room is available to be shared with other organizations during the day on Sundays and Mondays, and after 17:00 Monday to Sunday.
entries.quote_fr: 75 Capacity; $600 / Event; Venue Rental 60 people max $150 per hour; Fully Equipped Kitchen; Outside Catering Allowed; Le local est disponible pour être partagé avec d'autres organismes de jour les dimanches et lundis ainsi qu'après 17h du lundi au dimanche.
entries.review: The decision-bearing words are day-of-week and sharing. The terms do not permit a Saturday daytime programme and do not promise exclusive use; they also do not rule out a Sunday or Monday full day. The 8 h and 12 h states therefore stay unknown, not No, until a day is chosen.
entries.reviewer: jnr-research (French read; not a certified translator)
entries.source_locator: Event Pricing block; French description quoting the sharing terms

entries.gloss: Bookings are in blocks of 4, 8 or 12 hours; the clock is by appointment. Alcohol is permitted; 18 and over.
entries.quote_fr: Room rental — 4 hours 130 people max $195 per event; Room rental — 8 hours $257 per event; Room rental — 12 hours $334 per event; Alcool permis. 18 ans et plus. Réservations par blocs de 4, 8 ou 12 heures; heures sur rendez-vous.
entries.review: 'Blocs' is a rental duration and 'sur rendez-vous' means the start/end clock is agreed at booking, not that any start is guaranteed. The 12 h claim is therefore a duration claim, and the access window stays 'hours by appointment'.
entries.reviewer: jnr-research (French read; not a certified translator)

entries.gloss: Public signage and commercial advertising must be in French; French and another language are allowed only where French is markedly predominant in the same visual field.
entries.quote_fr: L'affichage public et la publicité commerciale doivent se faire en français. Ils peuvent être également faits à la fois en français et dans une ou plusieurs autres langues pourvu que tous les messages qui composent l'affichage soient rédigés en français et que l'ensemble des éléments figurant dans le même champ visuel permettent d'assurer la nette prédominance du français dans l'affichage.
